messages.content: The wedding hotel released a block room, so I want to compare it with the Hyatt House we had selected. The block is for Friday and Saturday nights, one room for two adults.
Send me the displayed totals, cancellation deadlines, checkout times, and any notes about breakfast or bag storage for each. I’ll compare the full stay rather than just the nightly rates.

The venue hotel is $684 including taxes. Saturday breakfast for two is included. Cancellation is free only until 6:00 p.m. Central on September 24, and checkout is 11:00 Sunday. The reception rooms are inside the hotel.
And the Hyatt House remains $612 including displayed taxes, correct? I also need its cancellation deadline, Sunday checkout time, and whether either property confirms storage after checkout.

Yes, $612 total. Hyatt cancellation runs until 11:59 p.m. Central on October 7, checkout is noon, and it is four blocks away. The listing says luggage storage, but it doesn’t specify hours. The venue hotel says storage is available, also without hours.

The Hyatt saves $72 and gives you an extra checkout hour plus a much later cancellation deadline. The venue hotel includes breakfast for two and eliminates outdoor travel between the room and the wedding events. Neither listing confirms that bags can remain until your planned 3:45 p.m. Sunday pickup, so that needs direct confirmation.
Please also check the room amenities. The venue king lists a coffee maker but no refrigerator. Hyatt lists both a coffee maker and mini-fridge.
That gives Hyatt the stronger room setup as well as the lower total. Is the missing refrigerator enough to rule out the venue room, or does direct access to the reception matter more for this stay?
For this wedding only, I’m willing to take the venue room without a refrigerator. Being able to go straight upstairs after the reception is worth the extra cost, especially with breakfast included.

Then the venue block is the better fit for this trip despite costing $72 more. Before payment, confirm that the $684 is the complete two-night total, breakfast covers both registered adults on Saturday, and there are no mandatory charges due at the hotel.
What about Sunday? Our flight is at 7:10 p.m., so we need the bags held well past checkout.

Ask the venue hotel to confirm storage from the 11:00 a.m. checkout until about 3:45 p.m. Sunday, with no requirement to retrieve the bags earlier and no fee. Your planned 4:00 p.m. departure for Midway can stay unchanged once that is confirmed.

Select the venue hotel, then. Prepare the guest details as Elena Ruiz and Mateo Ruiz, two adults, one king room. Elena should be the primary guest. Don’t submit anything until the storage and charges are confirmed.

Selected: the wedding-block king room at the venue hotel for Friday, October 9 through Sunday, October 11, for two adults, at the displayed $684 tax-inclusive total. Primary guest: Elena Ruiz. Second registered guest: Mateo Ruiz. Before booking, verify the exact room category, itemized total, absence of mandatory on-site charges, September 24 at 6:00 p.m. Central cancellation deadline, Saturday breakfast for both adults, 11:00 a.m. checkout, and complimentary luggage storage until approximately 3:45 p.m. Sunday. Do not submit payment until those points are confirmed. The previously selected Hyatt House room should remain unbooked and can serve as a fallback only while its rate and availability remain open.
